verses.english: The Chapter on the Peaceful Mind
“Mendicants, I will teach you the level of the untrue person and the level of the true person.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha. bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.

verses.english: “What is the level of the untrue person?
The untrue person is ungrateful and thankless,

verses.pali: Asabbhi hetaṁ, bhikkhave, upaññātaṁ yadidaṁ akataññutā akataveditā.
verses.english: for the wicked only know how to be ungrateful and thankless.

verses.pali: Kevalā esā, bhikkhave, asappurisabhūmi yadidaṁ akataññutā akataveditā. (…)
verses.english: It is totally the level of an untrue person to be ungrateful and thankless.

verses.pali: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, kataññū hoti katavedī.
verses.english: The true person is grateful and thankful,

verses.pali: Sabbhi hetaṁ, bhikkhave, upaññātaṁ yadidaṁ kataññutā kataveditā.
verses.english: for the virtuous only know how to be grateful and thankful.

verses.pali: Kevalā esā, bhikkhave, sappurisabhūmi yadidaṁ kataññutā kataveditā”ti.
verses.english: It is totally the level of a true person to be grateful and thankful.”
